title: Purchase manager opens the waiting order from the approval inbox and approves it: it becomes a purchase order

seeds.name: poNumber
seeds.sql: SELECT o.Number AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o.Status = 'ToApprove' ORDER BY o.Number DESC LIMIT 1

steps.name: Open Purchase > Approvals: the waiting order is listed
Approve: back in the inbox, the order no longer waits

outcome.label: the approved order is a confirmed purchase order with a confirmation date
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o.Number = '{{poNumber}}' AND o.Status = 'PurchaseOrder' AND o.ConfirmationDate != NULL
